data.body: SC-PARAMETER-PIN (sc-1): When implementing this story, the Figma REST API export call MUST pass scale=1 unconditionally. Viewport conformance (matching design.figma_viewport, default 1440x900) must be achieved via post-export resize (e.g., sharp/Pillow), NOT via the REST API scale parameter. Add an integration test asserting the outgoing request URL/params contain scale=1 and that the final PNG dimensions match the configured viewport. The current DD wording 'scale factor computation or post-export resize' allows scale != 1, which is permissive against SC-1's strict scale=1 requirement. Source: 2026-05-20 preplanning remediation pass against epic 4f8e-a7a6 SC↔DD coverage analysis.
